review.observer: Root performed App launch and navigation; /root/installed_baseline independently read saved artifacts.
review.priorRoleDisclosure: The independent reader authored earlier private control/build tooling and the candidate nine ready binding; this review is a later artifact read, not a blind design review.

navigation.initialLaunchSnapshot: New Conversation displayed; the retained-drafts row was visible.
navigation.loadingSnapshot: Opening the existing conversation displayed reading/loading placeholders.
navigation.loadedSnapshot: The existing conversation displayed historical messages and nonempty unsent composer text.

textComparison.method: For each private baseline fingerprint, independently locate the exact UTF-8 byte-length window once in saved AX16 and once in AX25, recompute SHA-256, and verify the UTF-16 length. No protected fragment text is published.
textComparison.visibleBoundary: The multiline composer is visible, but lower text is clipped by its visible area. Complete-fragment equality is established from AX rather than all pixels being visible together.

visibleControlsAfterLoad.permissionNoticeVisibleInImageAndAx: 继续发送前，请重新确认这条对话的权限。
visibleControlsAfterLoad.noSendOrPermissionChangeProvenance: Root readback receipt; the independent reader performed no UI actions.

limits: Only this existing conversation, four complete rendered fragments, saved snapshots and visible controls are covered. This does not establish complete history restoration or every draft.
Exact blank-line serialization and persistent-store representation were not read or compared; no SQL or live user-data read was performed for this review.
A mentioned file path or checksum is rendered text; attachment entity bytes, file decoding and Agent consumption were not tested.
The permission state still requires confirmation. No confirmation, permission change, new send, real Agent request or model execution was tested.
Before and after layouts differ, including the content panel and text wrapping. No pixel-identical layout or all-text-visible claim is made.
Still images and AX are sampled states, not a continuous trace. Launch/navigation count and absence of edits/sends are attributed to Root action records.
Historical stopped or uncertain work is not reclassified. The loaded header and historical labels do not prove completion or cancellation.
The closed before/preinstall/after retention manifests are a separate proof interval; this record does not claim those files remain byte-identical after legitimate first launch.
This narrow readback is not the formal affected P12 object check, full P12, real streaming, complete data or29-agent acceptance.
